crossRefs.note: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch…
Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us…
My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

translations.web: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
translations.bsb: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
translations.kjv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
translations.asv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thine ordinances.
